svg.text: Production flow analysis: part x machine matrix before and after clustering (T = 0.30)

Cell 2 (blue): HMC, DRILL, WASH – crankcases A, B, cover K, bracket
Cell 3 (orange): HONE, VMC – cylinders C1, C2, C3
e = 27 ones, exceptional elements = 2 (red circles: P03-DRILL, P07-GRIND), voids = 2
